title: Filipino-Style Bicol Express
description: A spicy Filipino dish made with shrimp and coconut milk. Bicol Express is a popular Filipino recipe that originated from the Bicol region.

ingredients.name: Fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Use as a substitute for salt

ingredients.name: Vinegar
ingredients.notes: Filipino vinegar or apple cider vinegar

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the pork belly and cook until browned.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, and vinegar.
Bring to a simmer and let cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Thai chili peppers and shrimp.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the shrimp are pink.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
